settings.label: Hold breath key
settings.description: While aiming. 'Sprint key' uses your sprint key (Shift); or a key name like Alt.

settings.label: Steadiness
settings.description: How much the sway drops while holding (0.75 = 75% less).

settings.label: Longest breath (seconds)
settings.description: Hold longer and you're left catching your breath, with extra sway.

settings.label: Recovery (seconds)
settings.description: Before you can hold your breath again.
